insights.implementation: Resolve accepted task/dependencies and inspect integrated evidence; retain one parent checkpoint and implement only authorized behavior.
insights.tdd: Use an independently derived literal oracle; observe intended RED then minimal GREEN one public behavior at a time.
insights.git-operation-guard: Classify semantic Git effects across global options; advisory regex is not a security boundary and classification never runs push.
insights.session-diagnostics: Identify the exact session, bound extraction by size, and distinguish observations, causes and historical versus current versions.
insights.plain-language-repitch: Lead with practical meaning and one concrete example; retain technical meaning while explaining terms.
insights.deep-module-design: Apply the deletion test and compare materially different signatures, invariants and dependency seams using actual caller obligations.
insights.pre-commit-setup: Inspect existing toolchain; preserve prepare/hooks and verify staged-writing tools in a disposable fixture or isolated index.
insights.primary-source-research: Trace each material claim to its owning source with version/date; separate fact, inference and unresolved gaps.
insights.search-first: Explicit technical research selects this owner; actual authorized source actions are separately required for USED.
insights.code-review: Pin owned untracked bytes and review independently against literal Spec and explicit Standards; report triggers and consequences at exact lines.
insights.workflow-specification: Make trigger/input/output/checkpoint/retry/permissions concrete; a specification does not activate schedules or messages.
insights.decision-interview: Reuse known facts and locked decisions; ask one discriminating human-choice question on the unblocked frontier.
insights.test-fixture-migration: Keep intentionally wrong inputs wrong, use test-only helpers where verified, and compare affected tests/typechecking.
insights.planning: Retain the existing plan; define consumes/produces signatures, DAG edges, independent acceptance and serialized shared files.
insights.debugging: Reproduce the exact symptom, test one falsifiable hypothesis and distinguish observed cause from proposed diagnosis.
insights.verification: Bind claims to current hashes, exact checks/exit/results and limitations; invalidate only evidence affected by byte drift.
insights.article-shaping: Keep raw material read-only, shape separate agreed moves and introduce concepts before dependent claims.
insights.api-and-interface-design: Atomically claim stable intent identity, reject payload conflicts and preserve UNKNOWN remote outcomes for reconciliation.
insights.delivery: Report current criteria and exact remaining action; checks never grant commit, push or publication permission.
insights.code-simplification: Start after GREEN, preserve outputs/errors/effect order and protected block bytes; stop if semantics change.
insights.shipping-and-launch: Decide advance/hold/rollback from actual baselines, budget and recovery readiness; offline decisions do not prove live rollout.
insights.task-decomposition: Use narrow observable deliverables with genuine blockers; wide renames use expand, migrate caller batches, then contract.
insights.incremental-implementation: Choose the smallest ready working task, respect dependencies/shared ownership and stop dependent progression on failed gates.
